basic_details.job_title: GSSSB Overseer, Class 3 Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB), Gandhinagar, has invited applications for the post of Overseer, Class-3 under Advt No. 471/202627. The online application is open from 1 December 2026 to 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only: debit card, internet banking, UPI or wallet; transaction fee is extra. Last date to pay the fee: 18 December 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Diploma in Civil and Surveyor or Draftsman (Civil) or Civil Planning and Drafting or Building and Architect Design; basic computer knowledge; adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both
qualification.details: Qualification: Diploma in (Civil) and Surveyor or Draftsman (Civil) or Civil Planning and Drafting or Building and Architect Design, from a recognised institution, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government; Basic knowledge of computer application as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967; Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both Age limit: 18 to 33 years (as on 15 December 2026) Age relaxation: General category Divyang men 10 years (maximum 45 years), General category Divyang women 15 years (10+5, maximum 45 years), Reserved category Divyang men 15 years (5+10, maximum 45 years), Reserved category Divyang women 20 years (5+10+5, maximum 45 years) | Other conditions: | Candidate must be an Indian citizen or hold nationality as per Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Reserved category age relaxation and benefits are only for candidates originally from Gujarat. Candidates without a computer knowledge certificate may apply but must produce one before appointment.

salary_details.pay_scale: Fixed pay Rs. 40,800 per month for the first five years; then Level-5 Rs. 29,200 - Rs. 92,300

exam_pattern.details: Negative marking: 1/4 of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for a wrong answer. Provisional answer key is published, and the final key follows after objections. Candidates with benchmark disability who cannot write may get scribe or 20 minutes compensatory time per hour. Exam date and admit card details will be placed on https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in.

how_to_apply: Register on the OJAS website (OTR) if not already registered.
Go to https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in, open Online Application, click Apply and select GSSSB.
Click the post name of advertisement 471/202627, Overseer, Class-3, then Apply now.
Enter Registration No. and date of birth, click Apply with OTR, and fill personal, SSC, bank account and educational details.
Upload photograph and signature, then click Confirm Application to get the confirmation number.
Pay the exam fee online by 18-12-2026 and print the application form and fee receipt.
important_instructions: The fee is refunded to candidates who appear for the examination; not refunded if the application is cancelled or the candidate is absent. Only the last confirmed application is valid if more than one is submitted. After confirmation, no change is possible; category cannot be changed later. Vacancies may increase or decrease; the Board may change or cancel the recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Diploma in (Civil) and Surveyor or Draftsman (Civil) or Civil Planning and Drafting or Building and Architect Design, from a recognised institution, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government; Basic knowledge of computer application as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967; Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both Age limit: 18 to 33 years (as on 15 December 2026) Age relaxation: General category Divyang men 10 years (maximum 45 years), General category Divyang women 15 years (10+5, maximum 45 years), Reserved category Divyang men 15 years (5+10, maximum 45 years), Reserved category Divyang women 20 years (5+10+5, maximum 45 years) Other conditions: Candidate must be an Indian citizen or hold nationality as per Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Reserved category age relaxation and benefits are only for candidates originally from Gujarat. Candidates without a computer knowledge certificate may apply but must produce one before appointment.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GSSSB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates not in the B, LV disability group cannot apply for this post. Candidates debarred by GPSC, other recruitment boards or government bodies during the debarment period are rejected.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment on fixed pay of Rs. 40,800 per month for the first five years. After five years, regular appointment in Level-5 (Rs. 29,200 - Rs. 92,300) if service is satisfactory, subject to SLP No.14124/2012 and 14125/2012. Appointed candidates must undergo government training and pass the training exam.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online only: debit card, internet banking, UPI or wallet; transaction fee is extra. Last date to pay the fee: 18 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will GSSSB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Single-stage objective MCQ competitive examination (CBRT/OMR) in Part-A and Part-B Provisional result and provisional merit list Certificate verification of about twice the number of posts Selection list and waiting list Part-A: reasoning and data interpretation 30 marks, mathematics 30 marks, Constitution, current affairs and Gujarati and English comprehension 30 marks. Part-B: questions on the relevant subject and its application, 120 marks. Separate qualifying standard of 40% in Part-A and in Part-B for all categories. About twice the number of posts are called for certificate verification in order of marks. Sports-qualified and widow women candidates get 5% of marks obtained added to their marks.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Negative marking: 1/4 of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for a wrong answer. Provisional answer key is published, and the final key follows after objections. Candidates with benchmark disability who cannot write may get scribe or 20 minutes compensatory time per hour. Exam date and admit card details will be placed on https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Original certificates of educational qualification, age, school leaving certificate and category (SC/ST/SEBC/EWS) for verification. Disability certificate in Form V, VI or VII under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2017. SEBC non-creamy layer certificate or EWS certificate, in the formats and periods the notice names. Sports certificate or widow candidate proof, if claiming 5% extra marks. Passport-size white-background photograph with date (not older than one year from last date) and signature. First page of bank passbook (JPEG, JPG or PNG) for fee refund.

content_sections.text: The fee is refunded to candidates who appear for the examination; not refunded if the application is cancelled or the candidate is absent. Only the last confirmed application is valid if more than one is submitted. After confirmation, no change is possible; category cannot be changed later. Vacancies may increase or decrease; the Board may change or cancel the recruitment.
